704K likes, 11K comments - foodpharmer on May 11, 2024: "Full version with more celebrities on YouTube! Link in bio. 
 
Challenge details:
·  Upload a story or a post with a label.
·  Challenge 3 more people to do the same.
·  Tag food pharmer if you want me to repost (optional).
·  Use the Label Padhega India music which is available on Instagram music library
 
Get your kids, friends, office colleagues to participate in this challenge! I will also give some gifts to 100+ people and personally meet some people who do these challenge!
 
Label Padhega India is a health movement to fight against all the food scandals happening in India! Every week we hear of a new food issue such as the Baby formula, Children’s health drink, Indian chips having Palm oil and the Masala-cancer issue.
 
If majority of us started reading labels, companies will be forced to stop false marketing and start giving us better quality food!
 
Let us all unite and transform India from the Diabetes Capital of the world to the Health Capital of the World!
 
Note- Full credits on YouTube.".

950K likes, 7,962 comments - foodpharmer on November 18, 2023: "Share this to spread the word! Just imagine if every school canteen, college mess, and office canteen had a sugar-board displaying the exact amount of sugar in every soft-drink! 

Habits form at an early age, and if we have a lot of sugar as a kid, chances are we will crave sugar as an adult too!
 
If you end up creating a sugar board, tag me in your story, and I will reshare it!
 
Disclaimer: There is no intention to defame any brand. Everything shared in this video is a personal opinion and purely for educational purposes. I do not own any copyright of any logos shown. Having excess sugar on a regular basis may potentially raise the risk of diabetes.".

13K likes, 236 comments - foodpharmer on October 29, 2026: "Yeast Protein Cocoa is finally HERE!

But why did we launch yeast protein when plant and whey protein already exist?

The reason we launched yeast protein is that it is more affordable than whey.

And it could also be a good alternative for those who don’t enjoy the taste of plant protein!

We’ve kept the ingredient list simple: 

1. Yeast protein isolate
2. Cocoa 
3. Stevia 

That’s it! No unnecessary fillers, no added colours, and no fancy claims like “gut-friendly” to influence you to buy something you don’t need.

We always say, don’t trust us, test us!

Yeast Protein Cocoa is now available on the Only What’s Needed app and website. (Link in bio!)

Let’s Make India Protein Sufficient!".

8,397 likes, 47 comments - foodpharmer on October 25, 2026: "How toothpaste brands fool you! 

Full podcast out now on my YouTube channel “Food Pharmer”.

From teeth whitening, charcoal toothpaste, oil pulling and the marketing of children’s toothpaste, how much of what we see is science, and how much is marketing?

In this episode, I sit down with @iampuneetnandaindia , an oral care expert to discuss:
• Toothpaste Marketing Gimmicks
• How to Read a Toothpaste Label
• The Truth About “9 Out of 10 Dentists Recommend”
• How to choose the right toothbrushes 
• How to buy the right toothpaste
• How to fix bad breath
• Children’s Toothpaste Marketing

This conversation aims to help you understand oral care products better, ask the right questions, and make informed decisions for yourself and your family.

#collab".

61K likes, 1,231 comments - foodpharmer on October 21, 2026: "Animal medicine sold to humans in India!

Imagine buying medicine for your child, only to find out that it was actually meant for animals.

In Surat, a medical shop owner was arrested for allegedly repackaging animal medicine into smaller bottles and selling it as human medicine using fake labels.

What makes this even more concerning is that this shop has reportedly been operating for the last 20 years. Just imagine how many fake bottles may have been sold during this time.

Medicines are meant to save lives, not put them at risk. Yet, people are willing to put human lives at risk just to make a profit.

We need stricter action against counterfeit medicines and those responsible for selling them.

Let’s Make India Healthy Again! 🇮🇳

Note: This is not Himalaya’s fault. In fact I feel bad for Himalaya as its products were misused in this case.".

23K likes, 272 comments - onlywhatsneeded on October 20, 2026: "This is my first ever time being on a billboard!

At Only What’s Needed, we don’t spend on paid promotions, so I’m extremely grateful to @selvel1945 for helping us put up this billboard for free, once again.

But this billboard comes at a particularly special time because, after 6 long months of being out of stock and having to destroy 15,000 packs that failed our pesticide test, our Plant Protein is FINALLY BACK! This time, in Cocoa.

But we didn’t want to simply bring it back. We wanted to make it better. This one tastes way better than our earlier plant protein. 

Earlier, we tested only our finished product. Now, we’ve added 20+ tests on our raw materials alongside our existing finished-product testing to make our quality checks even more rigorous.

Plant Protein Cocoa is now available on the Only What’s Needed app and website.

Let’s make India protein-sufficient, together! 🇮🇳".

67K likes, 738 comments - foodpharmer on October 19, 2026: "India’s YELLOW Water Crisis! 

Nashik’s groundwater has a shocking story that every Indian needs to know!

A lab report found Chromium 6, a cancer-causing chemical, in a water sample at 1,000 times the permissible limit.

Around 80 metal-plating industries operate in the area, and industrial pollution is linked to this groundwater contamination.

Medical screening has also identified skin diseases and allergies among 109 people.

Millions of pilgrims are expected at the 2027 Nashik Kumbh Mela, we cannot afford to turn a blind eye to this crisis.

Please share this video, especially with people in Maharashtra. The more people who know about this crisis, the harder it becomes to ignore.

The people of Nashik deserve answers, accountability, and immediate action.

Let’s make India’s water safe again!

Visuals from @thebetterindia".

96K likes, 1,085 comments - foodpharmer on October 17, 2026: "CATTLE FEED IN PRIYA GOLD BISCUITS?!

FSSAI recently inspected Priya Gold’s manufacturing facility.

They found sacks of bran marked as “Intended for cattle use,” along with reported concerns regarding hygiene and pest control.

So why were sacks labelled for cattle use found inside a biscuit manufacturing facility?

It’s time that food companies start taking accountability & not take consumers’ health for granted!

Please share this video so it reaches more Indians!

Let’s keep fighting the system & let’s make India healthy again! 

#priyagoldbiscuits".

8,259 likes, 132 comments - foodpharmer on October 16, 2026: "PLANT PROTEIN IS BACK!

According to Consumer Reports, plant protein generally contains more heavy metals than whey protein.

That’s why, at Only What’s Needed, our Plant Protein Cocoa is put through 7 rigorous third-party lab tests.

We’ve kept it simple - You pay for the quality of the product, not for the marketing.

Our Plant Protein Cocoa is now available on our website. Link in bio! @onlywhatsneeded 

Note: This doesn’t mean that plant protein is unsafe. It just means that there is a higher possibility of plant protein containing heavy metal than whey protein. 

Source: Consumer Reports, Oct 2025. 
Clean Label Project 2024-25".
